0-nfl.first_audit_reason: Three passages must change. (1) Excerpt: "opened Sunday at 43 to 43.5" calls Sunday's prices opening lines. The evidence says these historical quotes are not openers. It should say books listed 43 to 43.5 as of 7:12 AM EDT Sunday. (2) Price sensitivity: "The stored data shows no history for how often totals in this range finish on exactly that number" refers to internal data. Rephrase without naming data stores, for example "we did not check how often totals in this range land on exactly 43." (3) Hook: "none can be tied to the move with this data" also points to internal data. Rephrase to say the two snapshots, at 7:15 PM EDT Saturday and 7:12 AM EDT Sunday, show the move but not its cause. One smaller fix: "a one-point decline across the board" should be limited to the 10 books priced in both snapshots, because Bovada had no Saturday price. Everything else checks out against the evidence: kickoff time, records, the Rodgers stats, travel details, prices and times, and the model figures and caveats.
